extracted.intended_audience: Principal Investigators (PIs) using eRA Commons to view application review outcomes
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for PIs on how to access and interpret the Summary Statement (review outcome) for an NIH application via eRA Commons, and the key fields shown in the Status/Review screens.

rubrics_metrics.name: Summary Statement contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary Statements are PDF documents combining reviewers' written comments and the Scientific Review Officer's (SRO) summary of the discussion surrounding your application during the review meeting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This document contains the review outcome and is the primary place for reviewers' critiques and the SRO's synthesis; PIs can open it from the Status Information screen via the 'Other Relevant Documents' section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability / release timing
rubrics_metrics.description: As a PI, you can view your application's Summary Statement using the Status Information screen once it has been released by the SRO following the review meeting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You must wait until the SRO releases the Summary Statement; it is not available before release.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to access Summary Statement (navigation steps)
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps to locate and open the Summary Statement in eRA Commons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Log into Commons → Navigate to the Status module → Click the List of Applications/Grants section → Toggle Grouped or Flat view as desired → Click the application ID link → On the Status Information screen, expand 'Other Relevant Documents' and select the 'Summary Statement' link (opens in separate window).

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact Score
rubrics_metrics.description: Impact Score is displayed in the Review section of the Status Information screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Found in the abbreviated review information; used as a primary quantitative reviewer assessment metric shown to PIs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percentile
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentile is displayed in the Review section of the Status Information screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown alongside Impact Score as a comparative metric indicating relative standing among applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early Stage Investigator Eligible flag
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicates whether the application/PI is eligible as an Early Stage Investigator (ESI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed in the Review section to signal eligibility status that may affect review or funding considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Investigator Eligible flag
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicates whether the applicant is eligible as a New Investigator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed in the Review section as an eligibility marker for consideration by reviewers or program staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible for FFATA Reporting flag
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicates whether the application is eligible for FFATA reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative flag shown in the Review section; FFATA = Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act reporting eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Document Number
rubrics_metrics.description: Award Document Number is shown in the Application/Review section of the Status Information screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative identifier for the application/award; included in the abbreviated review information.

rubrics_metrics.name: FSR Accepted Code
rubrics_metrics.description: FSR Accepted Code is displayed as part of the application status information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the status codes shown on the Status Information screen; refer to era_status_codes.pdf for possible values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Snap Indicator Code
rubrics_metrics.description: Snap Indicator Code is displayed in the Status Information screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative/status indicator included in the abbreviated review information; specific meaning determined by NIH status code documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study Section / Scientific Review Group
rubrics_metrics.description: The Study Section or Scientific Review Group that reviewed the application is listed in the Review section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies the peer review panel responsible for the review; useful context for understanding reviewer expertise and panel norms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study Roster
rubrics_metrics.description: Study Roster is available in the Status Information review-related fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the list of reviewers/panel members involved in the review; can help PIs contextualize comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advisory Council / Council Meeting Date and Time
rubrics_metrics.description: Advisory Council meeting date and time (and Council Meeting Date/Time fields) are shown in the Status Information screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These schedule fields indicate when advisory council review/consideration may occur; included in the abbreviated review information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tip regarding Other Transaction Authority (OTA)
rubrics_metrics.description: Other Transaction Authority (OTA) — Some screens and terminology may be different to accommodate review of OTA, a type of award that is neither a grant nor a contract.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your application is reviewed under OTA, expect some eRA Commons screens/terminology to differ; these changes typically will not be visible to NIH or agency reviewers.
